feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Tributes to Gloria Steinem are flooding in, from Hollywood to Capitol Hill
entry.summary: Women in politics and pop culture are paying tribute to Gloria Steinem after her death at 92. Many called her not only an inspiration but a friend.

entry.title: Later in life, Gloria Steinem found herself free of the 'demands of gender'
entry.summary: In 2015, the trailblazing feminist told Fresh Air she that had entered a new phase in life, one in which "you can do what you want." Steinem died Sept. 2 at the age of 92.

entry.title: ICE officer faces federal charges for lying over shooting of Venezuelan immigrant
entry.summary: The charges represent a rare moment of the Justice Department seeking to hold immigration officers accountable.

entry.title: Fox News star Maria Bartiromo is out at the network
entry.summary: Fox News suddently announced it had cut ties with anchor Maria Bartiromo after more than a dozen years.

entry.title: Kissing apes, anti-splash urinals: This year's Ig Nobels showcase surprising science
entry.summary: The Ig Nobel Prizes were awarded this week for humorous yet thought-provoking research. This year, the ceremony came with a twist.

entry.title: Dems demand DHS fund election security. And, journalist Gloria Steinem has died
entry.summary: Two Democrats are demanding that Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of the midterms. And, trail-blazing journalist Gloria Steinem has died.

entry.title: Gloria Steinem, trailblazing journalist and activist, dies at 92
entry.summary: At a time when women were largely limited to domestic roles, Steinem challenged gender stereotypes and championed feminist ideals like equality, sisterhood and reproductive freedom.

entry.title: An epic train chase is turning 100 — and Buster Keaton fans are celebrating
entry.summary: 100 years ago, silent film star Buster Keaton filmed The General in Cottage Grove, Ore. Fans are gathering there to celebrate the making of an epic early film.

entry.title: Democrats demand Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of midterms
entry.summary: The lawmakers wrote that they share "grave concern that time is running out … to assist state and local election officials in protecting our elections from cyber and mis-and disinformation threats."

entry.title: As millions of kids lose SNAP food benefits, free school meals are also at risk
entry.summary: Food stamps have a direct link to other critical resources, such as free breakfast and lunch at school. Now, experts say they're starting to see that link break.
